m-jacksonville|2024-12-03|a73a8867|d63db.title: The motion for the emergency was approved unanimously via a voice vote. Phillip Peterson explained the Rules amendment which was approved unanimously via a voice vote. Council Member Diamond asked about the growth of the Salesforce project’s cost. Wanyonyi Kendrick, Director of Technology Solutions, said the cost of the Salesforce system will be partially offset by savings from another tech project that will be cancelled, and Salesforce will provide operational savings. Mr. Diamond asked what the overall budget is for the Salesforce project; Ms. Kendrick said $1.7M and she only knows of 1 additional item being added to the project for the next budget year. Mr. Peterson said the long-term financial commitment for Salesforce will have increased to $6.8M within less than a year if this bill is passed. Mr. Diamond asked that Salesforce initiative spending commitments be tracked. Council Member Lahnen asked for an update from the administration on the growth in health care insurance costs as well.

m-jacksonville|2024-12-03|a73a8867|f98a1.title: Phillip Peterson explained the amendment which was approved unanimously via a voice vote. Council Member Lahnen said this bill would bring the total of future commitments for economic incentives to $167M in the context of impending budget deficits over the next several years. He will reluctantly vote yes because the incentive payout period has been modified to the City’s benefit, but he foresees future budgetary problems looming.
